template_data.lead_html: Most companies ask for a Schedule. Fewer ask if it's the right vehicle.

rows.what_html: Broad commercial access — 20,000+ holders, high competition
Professional services task orders — tougher eval, stronger field
IT hardware & solutions — tighter scope, thinner competition

template_data.closer: PICK THE VEHICLE THAT FITS. NOT THE ONE THAT SOUNDS FAMILIAR.
